7.5.1 Campus Security and Safety Unit
CSSU upon receiving information about an occurring or likely emergency, shall gather as much
information as possible and immediately communicate to ERO, or any member of the ERT and
followed by following actions for all emergency situations including but not limited to:
«Depending on the level of emergency, contact and request all necessary agencies such as
Police and Fire Emergency Response Agency responders as appropriately.
«Shall direct the immediate response of emergency assistance (Police, Fire, Ambulance)
based on the outcome of the emergency. (Building, fire, environmental hazard etc.)
«In the event of a Level 2 or 3 emergency, notify the SDVC & P/ Director FM or duty
supervisor FM.
In the event of Level 3 emergency, the Director, CSSU or his designee will update the
situation and advise the MD/CEO and appropriate Leadership Team Members.
answer:
You should contact the Campus Security and Safety Unit (CSSU) immediately after receiving information about an occurring or likely emergency by:

* Calling their office
* Sending an email to: [CSSU Email]
* Reporting to ERO, ERT, or any member of the Executive Management Team (EMT)

For Level 2 or 3 emergencies, you should notify the SDVC & P/ Director FM. For Level 3 emergencies, the CSSU will update the situation and advise MD/Ceo and Leadership Team Members.
